assessment: Potato maltodextrin is an ingredient in one commercial xanthan-based thickener. The study used trained panels to characterize thickened liquids with or without barium, without testing a baked-potato bolus or patient swallowing severity.

The KNHANES cross-sectional survey compares usual intake across people reporting or not reporting chewing difficulty. It combines steamed and grilled potato in one food-frequency item. It supplies no baked potato exposure contrast, dysphagia outcome or Parkinson subgroup.

Potato starch appears in the allergy exclusion criteria, and Parkinson disease is an excluded neurologic diagnosis. The six included stroke patients underwent saliva and liquid-barium swallowing tests.
